title: Agential self-generation (the defining platform property)
description: Per platform-opener: 'The defining property is agential self-generation: the operations agents use are themselves entities in the substrate the agents act on. A skill that audits skills is a skill. A shape that validates shapes is a shape. The org chart is in the predication-graph store.' This $thing declares the property's witness for our platform — listing the categories of operations + their substrate-entity status.
